home.descriptionA: Sinia ful-stak injinia wit 6+ ia ɛkspiriɛns fɔ tek prɔdak frɔm ambiguous rikwaymɛnt to rili prodakshɔn sistɛm. A disayn di akitɛkɛt biɛn Riakt, Angular, .NET, Node.js, Java, C#, Go, ɛn SQL aplikeshɔn dɛn: klia savis bɔda, durable data mɔdel, sikyuɔr akses patɛn, ɛn dilivεri pat dεm tim dεm kin כpεret wit kכnfidεns.
home.descriptionB: Mi wok de kɔnɛkt di tin dɛn we a kin disayd fɔ du wit injinɛri to di tin dɛn we kin apin to di biznɛs. Frɔm wan kɔnstrɔkshɔn-ɛstimat SaaS we de tɔn sprɛdshit data to klaynt-rɛdi prɔpɔzal to rɛvɛnyu-jɛnereshɔn wɛb pletfɔm, a bil sɔftwɛl rawnd di wokflɔ, risk, ɛn valyu we dɛn kin mɛzhɔ we impɔtant to di pipul dɛn we de yuz am.

personal_summary.title: Pɔsin in Sɔma
personal_summary.text: Mi na wan sinia ful-stak injinia we de na Orlando, FL we gɛt di rod frɔm prodak prɔblɛm to prodakshɔn autkam. I mek teknɔlɔji chuk in savis fɔ di sistɛm: .NET ɛn Entity Framework Core we wan strɔng strɔkchɔ domɛyn ɛn testable persistence mata; Angular ɔ Riak we kɔmpleks wokflɔ nid wan intafɛs we dɛn kin mentenɛt; Node.js ɔ Go we wan API, intagreshɔn, ɔ ay-pɔfɔmɛnshɔn tul nid fɔ gɛt fɔs rɔntaym. Akɔdin to SaaS prodak, intanɛnt wokflɔ, ɛn kɔstɔma-fes pletfɔm, a de lid wit klia tred-ɔf, sikyu ɛn resilient dizayn, ɔtomatik tɛst, ɛn delivri prɔsis we ɛp tim dɛn fɔ ship valyu softwe we nɔ lɛf ɔpreshɔnal dɛt biɛn.

entries.title: Ful Stak Ɛnjinia
entries.text: A de lid ɛnd-to-ɛnd prodak delivri: translet biznɛs wokflɔ to sistɛm bɔda, data mɔdel, API, ɛn intafɛs, dɔn a kɛr di wok tru tɛst, diploymɛnt, . ɛn itɛreshɔn. Di gol na sɔftwɛl we wan tim kin ebul fɔ evolv ɛn ɔpreshɔn, nɔto fɔ gɛda skrin dɛn we nɔ gɛt kɔnekshɔn.

entries.title: Prodakt & Plɛtfɔm Akitekchɔ
entries.text: A kin pik pletfɔm ɛn patɛn bays pan di prɔblɛm: layt .NET savis fɔ biznɛs domɛyn, kɔmpɔnɛnt-driv Angular ɔ Riak aplikeshɔn fɔ kɔmpleks ɔpreshɔn, rileshɔnal data models fɔ akauntabl wokflɔ, ɛn intagreshɔn dɛn we dɛn disayn wit fayl mɔd, akses kɔntrol, ɛn mentenɛns na maynd.

entries.title: Prodakshɔn-Rɛdi Dilivri
entries.text: A bil wit di rialiti dɛn afta lanch in view: sikrit dɛn we dɛn kip aut ɔf sɔs kɔntrol, ɛksplisit database maykreshɔn pat, rol-bɛs ɔtorizeshɔn, validɛshɔn na sistɛm bɔda, ɔtomatik tɛst, CI/CD ɔwe, ɛn prɛktikal ɔbshɔbibiliti. Dis na di ditel dɛn we de tɔn wan protɔtayp to sɔftwɛl we pɔsin kin abop pan.

biblioteca.title: Di buk we nem JSON
biblioteca.text: Wan Paytɔn-bɛs lokalizayshɔn paiplayn we de tɔn wan strɔkchɔ kɔntinyu sɔs to wan glob ɔl aksesbul pɔtfɔlio. I de handle transleshɔn data as wan sistem we dɛn kin mentenɛt pas fɔ duplikɛt pej kɔpi wit yu an, we de alaw di sayt fɔ skel akɔdin to 100+ langwej dɛn ɛn mek di glob ɔl rich an opareshɔnal kapabiliti instead ɔf wan tɛm ficha.

connect_four.title: Kɔnekt Fo
connect_four.text: Massive famili of ova 50+ implimentishɔn dɛn fɔ di Kɔnɛkt Fo gem. Dis projɛkt inklud implimɛnt dɛn insay pas 30 difrɛn programin langwej dɛn, we inklud Java, C++, Paytɔn, JavaSkript, ɛn ɔda wan dɛn. Apat frɔm dat, i inklud bak pas 20+ difrɛn freym ɔ ɔda fɔmat dɛn, we inklud React.js, Ruby on Rails, ASP.NET, ɛn mɔ.

grocery_app.title: Ap fɔ di tin dɛn we dɛn kin bay
grocery_app.text: Wan ful-stak .NET 9 Blazor Server aplikeshɔn we de sho intenshɔnal bakɛnd akitɛkɛt fɔ wan biznɛs wokflɔ. Di kɔntrol/savis/ripɔsitɔri split de kip aplikeshɔn lɔ dɛn, data akses, ɛn prɛzɛntɛnshɔn indipɛndɛnt wan we dɛn kin tɛst; Entity Framework Core de gi pɔsin we go kɔntinyu fɔ de; ɛn di komprehensiv tεst suit de protεkt bihayvya as di prodak de evolv.

interop.title: Interop Projek we dɛn kɔl
interop.text: Wan kros-langwej intaoparabiliti rɛfrɛns we span 15 programin langwej ɛn 18 ɛgzikishɔn patɛn. Di projɛkt de invɛstigat di bɔda usay sistɛm dɛn kin bi fraylayz bɔku tɛm: prɔses kɔntrakt, data ɛkshɛnj, rɔntaym bihayvya, ɛn ripit intagreshɔn pat. I de sho di sistɛm dɛn we de tink we dɛn nid we wan prɔdak big pas wan stak.

inventory_register.title: Invɛntari Rɛjista
inventory_register.text: Wan ful-stak POS ɛn invɛntari wokflɔ we dɛn bil wit Angular 17+ ɛn Node.js. I de mɔdel di ɔpreshɔnal kɔnsyans dɛm fɔ wan B2B sistɛm: ɔthɛntiket yuza dɛm, rol-bɛs akses kɔntrol, invɛntari akkuracy, ɛn wan mɔk pemɛnt flɔ. Di projɛkt de disayn arawnd di aktual wok we wan rɛjista tim de du, nɔto jɔs wan katalog fɔ di fremwɔk ficha dɛn.

formatter.title: JSON & YAML Ɔto Fɔmat
formatter.text: Wan brawza-based JSON ɛn YAML validɛshɔn ɛn fɔmat tul we dɛn bil insay Go ɛn kɔmpilayt to WebAssembly. We yu muv di parsing injin insay WASM, i de kip di intarakshɔn rispɔnsiv ɛn lokal to di brawza we yu de aplay rial pars fɔ kech invalid input. Na wan fɔs ɛgzampul fɔ pik wan rɔntaym akitɛkɛt fɔ pefɔmɛns, pɔtabiliti, ɛn yuz trɔst.

takeoff_engine.title: Tek-ɔf Injin
takeoff_engine.text: Wan kɔnstrɔkshɔn we de ɛstimat SaaS we dɛn bil rawnd wan kɔst, mistek-prone kɔntrakta wokflɔ. Di Riakt + Ɛkspɛs prodak de ingest CSV ɛn Excel data, map inkɔnsistɛns kɔlɔm dɛn insay wan yuzable domɛyn mɔdel, kɔlkul trench ɛkskavɛshɔn ɛn at wok volyum, trak leba ɛn mak-ap, ɛn prodyuz klayɛnt-rɛdi PDF ɛn Wɔd prɔpɔzal dɛn. Dis na ful prodak layfsaykl injinɛri: data parsing, kɔlkyulɛshɔn lɔ, wan polish ɔpreshɔn wokflɔ, ɛn deliverables we de ɛp wan biznɛs fɔ muv frɔm raw input to bid.

minecraft_json_generator.title: Minecraft JSON Jɛnɛratɔ we de wok
minecraft_json_generator.text: Laytwɛt JSON jenɛra we dɛn bil insay Paytɔn fɔ Minecraft risɔs & data pak dɛn. Dis projɛkt de yuz fɔ jenarayz JSON fayl dɛn fɔ Minecraft mods, inklud kɔstɔm tin dɛn, blɔk dɛn, ɛn ɛntiti dɛn. Rili yusful fɔ nɔto jɔs fɔ mek kɔstɔm datapak, bɔt fɔ mod dɛn bak via di mod nem swichin ficha.

educational_experience.title: Mi Edukeshonal Ɛkspiriɛns
educational_experience.text: Apat frɔm mi pasɔnal prɔjek dɛm, a dɔn gɛt bɔku skil dɛm bak frɔm di edyukeshɔn ɛkspiriɛns. Klik ya fɔ si mi LinkedIn prɔfayl fɔ no mɔ.

professional_experience.title: Mi Prɔfɛshɔnal Ɛkspiriɛns
professional_experience.text: Siks-plɔs ia pɔshɔnal injinɛri ɛkspiriɛns akɔdin to prodak tim dɛn, biznɛs pletfɔm dɛn, ɛn sɔftwɛl dɛn we de fes di kɔstɔma dɛn. Mi wok dɔn inklud fɔ bil aplikeshɔn layers we dɛn kin mentenɛt, fɔ wok togɛda akɔdin to di disiplɛn dɛn we de na di delivri, ɛn fɔ mek tɛknikal disizhɔn dɛn wit di prɔdak layfsaykl, we de wok risk, ɛn lɔng tɛm ɔnaship in view.

portfolio_website.title: Patrick Goodwin Pɔtfɔlio Wɛbsayt
portfolio_website.text: Wan prodakshɔn-maynd Riakt pɔtfɔlio we de trit aksesibiliti ɛn glob ɔl rich as injinɛri rikwaymɛnt. I inklud wan transleshɔn paip layn we dɛn kin mentenɛt fɔ 100+ langwej dɛn, intaraktiv tul dɛn we WebAssembly bak, rispɔnsiv ɛn aksesbul UI patɛn, ɛn wan prɔjek akitɛkɛt we dɛn mek fɔ gro as dɛn de ship nyu wok.

lua_library.title: Patrick in Lua Skript Laybri
lua_library.text: Wan yusful laybri fɔ Lua skript dɛn fɔ yuz tumara bambay. Dis laybri de yuz fɔ ɔtomayz wok dɛn na Lua skript, we kin kam fayn fɔ wok dɛn we nid fɔ pefɔmɛns, bikɔs Lua kin bi skriptin langwej we fast pas ɔl tu Paytɔn ɛn Rubi.

excel_scripts.title: Patrick in Maykrosoft Ɛksɛl Sprɛdshit Skript (VBA) .
excel_scripts.text: Wan yusful laybri fɔ VBA skript fɔ Maykrosoft Ɛksɛl. Dɛn kin yuz dis laybri fɔ ɔtomayz wok dɛn na Ɛksɛl sprɛdshit dɛn.

neovim_config.title: Patrick in Neovim Kɔnfig
neovim_config.text: Mi pasɔnal Neovim kɔnfigyushɔn. Dis projɛkt de yuz fɔ kɔnfigyut Neovim to mi lɛk, inklud kɔstɔm kibinding, tim, ɛn plɔgin. Dis projɛkt de yuz fɔ mek Neovim yuz-frenli ɛn efyushɔn fɔ mi pasɔnal yus.

python_maps.title: Patrick in Map Jɛnɛratɔ
python_maps.text: Wan Paytɔn jiospɛshal ripɔt tul we dɛn bil wit JioPandas ɛn Matplotlib fɔ mek U.S. kɔntri ɛn stet map dɛn. I de tɔn jiografik data to ridabl analisis artifakt, we de sho wan data paip layn maynd sɛt: pik di rayt domɛyn laybri dɛn, nɔmaliz input dɛn, ɛn prodyuz autput dɛn we sɔpɔt klia disizhɔn dɛn.

powershell_library.title: Patrick in PowerShell Skript Laybri
powershell_library.text: Wan yusful laybri fɔ PowerShell skript fɔ riferɛns tumara bambay. Yuzful wit di $profile skript ficha, a si se dis rili ɛp fɔ ɔtomayz wok frɔm di Windows tɛminal, as a na pɔsin we kin yuz di Windows OS bɔku tɛm.

ruby_library.title: Patrick in Rubi Skript Laybri
ruby_library.text: Wan yusful laybri fɔ Ruby skript fɔ riferɛns tumara bambay. Yuzful fɔ fiuja Ruby on Rails divɛlɔpmɛnt kɔnsɛpt dɛn.

pdf_builder.title: PDF Skil Bilda
pdf_builder.text: Wan dɔkyumɛnt-jɛnɛreshɔn wokflɔ we dɛn bil wit Paytɔn, Pdfkit, Jinja2, HTML, ɛn strɔkchɔ JSON data. I de separet data we yu kin yuz bak frɔm prɛzɛntɛnshɔn tɛmplat fɔ jenarayz tayla PDF rizyum dɛn ɔltɛm, we na prɛktikal patɛn fɔ ridyus manual wok ɛn mek biznɛs dɔkyumɛnt dɛn we dɛn kin ripit.

rijandel_encryption.title: Rijandel Enkripshɔn Projɛkt
rijandel_encryption.text: Wan kɔmparativ sɛt fɔ 10+ Rijndael implimɛnt dɛn akɔs 128-, 192-, ɛn 256-bit vɛryɔnt dɛn. Fɔ ri-implimɛnt wan sikyɔriti-sɛnsitiv algɔrithm akɔdin to langwej dɛn na wan disiplin ɛgzampul insay ɛksaktɔl spɛsifikɛshɔn dɛn, tɛstable bihayvya, ɛn di limit dɛn fɔ langwej-lɛvel pɔtabiliti, ɔl di yusful instinkt fɔ sistɛm dɛn we de handle sɛnsitiv data.

suprememc.title: SupremeMC Minekraft Mod
suprememc.text: Wan Minecraft Mod we de ad kɔstɔm tul dɛn, armor, mob, blɔk, dimɛnshɔn, ɛn bɔku ɔda tin dɛn to di gem. Dɛn bil am wit Java vɛshɔn 8-17 fɔ sɛlɛkɛt Minecraft vɛshɔn dɛn bitwin 1.16 ɛn 1.20.

tiger_programming_language.title: Tayga Progrɛm Langwej
tiger_programming_language.text: Wan kɔstɔm programin langwej ɛn intaprita we dɛn bil insay Go fɔ ɛksplɔrɔ langwej rɔntaym dizayn, ɛgzikishɔn bihayvya, ɛn pefɔmɛns tredɔf. Fɔ kɔmpilayt am to WebAssembly ɛn intagret am insay di pɔtfolio de mek wan rial, inspɛktabl prodak sɔfa fɔ sistɛm-lɛvel injinɛri pas fɔ lɛf di wok as a ripɔsitɔri-onli ɛkspiriɛns.

tiger_tailgating_pros.title: Tiger Tailgating Pros Wɛbsayt fɔ di wan dɛn we de wok
tiger_tailgating_pros.text: Wan React wɛbsayt we dɛn deliv fɔ wan Clemson, SC tailgating biznɛs. Di wok translet wan smɔl biznɛs in ɔfrin to wan klia kastoma joyn ɛn dipendabl wɛb prezɛns, aplay prodak tinkin fɔ ɛp wan rial ɔganayzeshɔn fɔ kɔnvɔyt intres insay inkyɔri ɛn revenyu.

turing_machine.title: Turing Mashin Projɛkt
turing_machine.text: Famili fɔ ova 30+ implimɛnt dɛn fɔ di Turing Mashin. Yuz fɔ sho turing kɔmplitnɛs fɔ difrɛn programin langwej fɔ risach, mɔ fɔ di Tayga Progrɛm Langwej.

contact.description: A kin ansa kwɛstyɔn dɛn frɔm imel ɛn LinkedIn mɛsej dɛn. A go kɔl bak bak if dɛn gi mi nɔmba bay rizyum ɔ ɔda we, pan ɔl we a lɛk fɔ kip mi fon nɔmba prayvet.

formatter.title: JSON & YAML Linter
formatter.description: Wan brawza-based data kwaliti tul we de validet ɛn fɔmat JSON ɛn YAML yuz wan Go injin we dɛn kɔmpilayt to WebAssembly. Di akitɛkɛt de kip de pars klos to di yuza fɔ fast, prayvet fidbak we i de ɛnfɔs rial sɛntaks lɔ dɛn na di data bɔda. Na wan kɔmpakt ɛgzampul fɔ disayn wan divɛlɔpa wokflɔ we pɔsin kin abop pan rawnd kɔrɛkt, pefɔmɛns, ɛn trɔst.

tiger.description: Tiger na kɔstɔm programin langwej ɛn Go intaprita we dɛn bil fɔ ɛksplɔrɔ rɔntaym akitɛkɛt, langwej sɛmantiks, ɛn pefɔmɛns tred ɔf.
